deliverable_state.Official warning applicability for a pla: implemented in scope: point-in-polygon on the official district geometry, IST day windows derived from the bulletin date, official hazard codes and colours stated, stale bulletins excluded, unmapped points reported as outside every district
deliverable_state.Warning lifecycle and delivery: open: no live update, cancel or supersede edition has been observed, no delivery or subscription exists, and a CAP lifecycle result still never authorises dissemination
deliverable_state.Origin authentication: open and stated as unverified on every answer and in the tool trace

stages.title: Language, resilience and desktop usability
deliverables: Desktop answer charts and source inspection
exit_checks: Fluent review and desktop journey checks pass

deliverable_state.Desktop answer charts and source inspect: implemented and recorded: eleven surfaces over a read-model API, with charts, per-surface provenance, limits and a vendored map
deliverable_state.Source health/retention/restore rehearsa: implemented and recorded: conversation ledger with search, restore and local delete, plus a read-only collection-health panel
deliverable_state.Queue, cancel, progress and recovery: cancel and progress only: still no bounded model queue and no stage streaming, and the assistant remains one question at a time
deliverable_state.Complete Hindi/Gujarati dialogue paths: not achieved: a requested output language is expressible and its failure is disclosed, and the surfaces themselves are English only
deliverable_state.Watch and early-warning delivery: not built: the Watch control states that no delivery mechanism is connected
